question: Should guided setup automatically enable Codex supervision whenever a native Codex installation is detected and policy permits?
rationale: This choice determines user consent for exposing native session metadata and archive-capable controls; source correctness cannot determine the intended product default.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Detect native Codex during setup but ask the user before enabling supervision and session metadata exposure.

options.title: Enable automatically
options.body: Keep automatic supervision activation after successful setup whenever policy permits it.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Detect native Codex during setup but ask the user before enabling supervision and session metadata exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Codex harness ownership and authored the linked issue and PR defining this setup and consent behavior.
